content.text: Villanova University Visiting Villanova Alumni Parents Near Villanova and Philadelphia Located on 254 acres in Radnor Township and only 12 miles from Center City Philadelphia, Villanova University is one of the Main Line's hallmark institutions. The University has three distinct areas: Main Campus, West Campus and South Campus. St. Thomas Of Villanova Church St. Thomas of Villanova Church is the spiritual heart of the University. The church is home to St. Thomas of Villanova Parish, which has Masses Sunday mornings. In addition, several University Masses are celebrated on Sunday evenings. The dual spires of the church are the highest point on campus, and serve as a landmark for students and families visiting Villanova.
